title: OmniPhysicsSurfaceDeformableMaterialAPI
summary: Surface (cloth) properties of an OmniPhysics deformable material. A material that lists it becomes a PxDeformableSurfaceMaterial; its elasticity, friction and density come from OmniPhysicsDeformableMaterialAPI and OmniPhysicsBaseMaterialAPI (USD lists both as its built-ins).

columns.name: omniphysics:surfaceThickness
columns.absent: 0.0 on a material the walker enumerates: PhysX gets zero thickness, and without omniphysics:mass the density-derived vertex mass uses max(thickness, FLT_EPSILON), so it is nearly zero. The material bound to the PhysicsScene, which also becomes the scene's default deformable material, starts from the consumer default instead: 0.001 m in stage units (0.001 / metersPerUnit).
columns.notes: Re-read on change and applied to the PhysX material, followed by a mass update of the bound bodies.

columns.name: omniphysics:surfaceStretchStiffness
columns.absent: 0.0. Parsed onto the descriptor but never passed to PhysX.
columns.notes: A change only logs 'Surface Stretch Stiffness is currently not supported'.

columns.name: omniphysics:surfaceShearStiffness
columns.absent: 0.0. Parsed onto the descriptor but never passed to PhysX.
columns.notes: A change only logs 'Surface Shear Stiffness is currently not supported'.

columns.name: omniphysics:surfaceBendStiffness
columns.absent: 0.0: the PxDeformableSurfaceMaterial is created with bending stiffness 0, the PhysX default; the schema's derivation from youngsModulus and surfaceThickness is not done by the runtime.
columns.notes: Re-read on change and applied to the PhysX material.

interactions.rule: The surface columns are read only when this API is listed; the material's other columns follow OmniPhysicsDeformableMaterialAPI and OmniPhysicsBaseMaterialAPI and their own usd-schemas gates.
